title: lithocarpus crassinervius
intro: Lithocarpus crassinervius, commonly known as the Taiwanese walnut, is a species of plant in the beech family, Fagaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with various health benefits including the ability to reduce inflammation, lower cholesterol levels, and act as an antioxidant, which can help protect against cell damage and reduce the risk of certain diseases. The therapeutic actions of Lithocarpus crassinervius are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
